criteria_results.criterion: Head identifies the missing named capability, performs one bounded acquisition and replans with an actually qualified local procedure.
criteria_results.notes: All three parts pass this criterion. probe/qualification-run-1/qualification_receipt.json (rev 3) names the missing capability 'observation-digest-v1', records exactly one bounded acquisition (single stdlib-only source at the stable in-scope path procedures/observation_digest_v1.py, sha256 7881ed13…, no packages/network) and a replan block that is QUALIFIED. Qualification is executed, not asserted: probe exit 0, empty stderr, captured stdout/hashes, determinism re-run, and nine nonzero-exit negative cases. The model-authored-procedure risk in the spec is mitigated by actual execution plus independent re-derivation (Decimal checker, integer+awk engines, 61/61 Nox QA re-hash gate). Part 2 and part 3 do not hold the head's plan text but confirm the same single source path and single probe run from the preflight pin and receipt 'replan-and-invoke' step.

criteria_results.criterion: The acquired procedure is invoked with its exact qualified executable bytes and fixed arguments; a durable invocation receipt is present.
criteria_results.notes: All three parts pass. invocation_receipt.json (registered artifact, rev 2, 14,754 B, sha256 dce5422c…) records sha256_at_invocation == sha256_after_invocation == the qualified 7881ed13610034bb0a985cdd548a009ac2cdec8ec17f3532ca72453098e2b017 (16,350 B), matching the registered procedure and preflight_source.sha256.txt. invocation/argv.json and argv_compact.txt contain exactly the two spec-mandated fixed args [<root>/input/pilot.observations.json, <root>], with argv_2_equals_mission_root true and argv_2_is_probe_dir false, satisfying the no-probe-output-dir constraint. argv_compact sha256 142a50d0… matches the receipt's exact_ordered_argv_sha256 and is reproduced by audit_receipt.py; exit_code 0, empty stderr (e3b0c442…), stdout names root outputs only. Minor provenance weaknesses (post-hoc reconstruction, stale inode/mtime after re-registration, identical start/end timestamps) are documented but do not undermine the content-addressed claims.

criteria_results.criterion: digest.json has exact numeric row_count, scheduled, completed, incidents, completion_percent (2 decimals), and a sites object keyed by site with totals; digest.md presents the same values with a reproducible method.
criteria_results.notes: All three parts independently recompute from input/pilot.observations.json (sha256 412c65c3…): 3 rows; scheduled 12+8+10=30; completed 11+8+7=26; incidents 2+1+3=6; 26/30=86.666…→86.67 half-up. Sites: North 2 rows, 22/18/5, 18/22=81.82; South 1 row, 8/8/1, 100.00; per-site figures reconcile to the globals in both directions. digest.json (989cc426…, 480 B) carries these as unquoted JSON numbers with two-decimal rendering and a sites object keyed by site with row_count/scheduled/completed/incidents/completion_percent. digest.md (7948f59a…, 1,603 B) reproduces identical totals plus per-site table and total row, the fixture sha256, and a '## Reproducible method' section with the half-up 2-decimal rule and the scheduled==0 → 0.00 convention. No placeholders anywhere. Three separate engines agree (independent_check 40/40, receipt audit 69/69, verify_independent 73/73).

criteria_results.criterion: All deliverables are registered artifacts whose bytes pass independent host verification and independent Nox QA.
criteria_results.notes: All three parts pass. digest.json (rev 2, 989cc426…, 480 B), digest.md (rev 1, 7948f59a…, 1,603 B) and invocation_receipt.json (rev 2, dce5422c…) are registered in the candidate with sizes and hashes matching on-disk claims in outputs.sha256.txt and the logs; the epoch's registrations carry ids, paths, sha256 and sizes. Independent host verification is green: verification/verify_result.json reports 73 checks, 73 pass, 0 fail, verdict INDEPENDENT_ARITHMETIC_PARITY_OK, including exact-int type assertions, raw-token two-decimal checks, md/JSON cell parity and bidirectional per-site↔global reconciliation. Independent Nox QA (verification/nox_qa.log, 61/61, NOX_QA_PASS) re-hashes digest.json, digest.md, the procedure source and the receipt from disk rather than trusting producer prose. Only minor issues (a few vacuous hardcoded True checks in nox_qa.py, volatile inode/mtime fields) were found; none affect byte-level or arithmetic validity.

defects.issue: invocation_receipt.json retains invocation-time inode/output_mtime values for digest.json and digest.md that became stale when save_artifact re-registered the deliverables byte-identically; the receipt therefore carries fields no longer true of the live filesystem. Disclosed in a post_registration_note, so documented rather than concealed.

The invocation receipt is a post-hoc reconstruction by invocation/build_receipt.py rather than a contemporaneous capture, and an earlier version understated the fixture sha256 (4045… vs 4055…), retained as verification/prewrite_backup/invocation_receipt.json.orig (13,214 B vs final 14,754 B). Corrected and self-audited, but it means receipt values were once wrong.

Final digest.json/digest.md are byte-identical to probe/qualification-run-1 outputs (989cc426…, 7948f59a…), so freshness of the final invocation rests on determinism plus inode/mtime separation evidence that registration later invalidated; copying cannot be excluded by hash comparison alone.
start_utc.txt and end_utc.txt are identical (2026-11-16T08:30:19Z) with duration_seconds.txt = 0, so timestamps cannot independently order the qualification run against the final invocation.

verification/nox_qa.py contains vacuous assertions ('no additional/unknown top-level keys' and 'sha256 recorded' hardcoded True; null check is a raw substring search), which inflate the 61-check pass count, though the exact-key check already covers the substantive case.

The procedure renders South completion as 100.00 while the receipt's digest_values block records 100.0 — numerically identical but inconsistent formatting for a snapshot that could be read as a second source of truth.

recommendations: Drop inode/mtime from invocation_receipt.json in favour of sha256 + byte-size + argv provenance, or re-capture them after the final save_artifact registration.
Re-run audit_receipt.py and verify_independent.py against post-registration bytes and register the fresh logs so green verdicts provably postdate registration.
Strengthen freshness provenance with a run-unique nonce echoed in stdout and stored in the receipt instead of relying on inode separation.
Replace hardcoded True checks in verification/nox_qa.py with real structural assertions (JSON traversal null scan, explicit key-set diff).
Normalise percentage rendering between digest.json/md and any receipt snapshot to two decimals.
